labels.title: Labels
labels.subtitle: Design the labels for equipment (linked to each type) and documents: the order shipping label, the lot document, or any other one (DYMO, a regular printer or "Save as PDF").
labels.no_templates: There are no templates yet. Create the first one.
labels.pick: Pick a template or create a new one.
labels.name: Name
labels.name_required: Enter a name for the template.
labels.rotation_hint: Use 90° if your printer feeds the label sideways.
labels.default_hint: Used for equipment types that have no template of their own.
labels.types_hint: When testing finishes, this label is printed for the checked types. Each type uses a single template.
labels.delete_msg: Its equipment types will fall back to the default template.
labels.discard_msg: You will lose what you changed in this template.
labels.canvas_hint: Drag to move; use the corner square to resize. Arrow keys: move · Del: remove.
labels.empty_canvas: The label is empty. Add data from the left panel.
labels.none_selected: Select an element on the label to edit it.
labels.shrink: Shrink the font if the text does not fit
labels.dense_warning: Barcode is very dense ({{mm}} mm per thin bar): make it wider, shorten the content or use a QR so it scans well.

print.title: Print labels
print.no_template: There are no label templates. Create one in Settings → Labels.
print.hint: The print dialog will open: pick your DYMO printer and the paper size that matches the label. To print without the dialog, start Chrome with the --kiosk-printing option.
print.label: Label

auto.hint: When a unit is finished, printing opens with the label linked to its type.

labels.doc_order_hint: Printed from the order, one label per package, with the customer name, weight and size. The default one is offered first; you can have several in different sizes.
labels.default_hint_order: It is the one offered first when printing an order's labels.
labels.doc_lot_hint: Printed from the lot's screen, with its data and a summary of its lines. Use it as a report, receiving sheet, or any document of your own for the lot.
labels.default_hint_lot: It is the one offered first when printing a lot's document.

custom.title: Print custom label
custom.hint: Pick a unit label template and type in the information you want it to show by hand. Nothing is saved or linked to any unit.
custom.no_fields: This template has no data fields to fill in (only fixed text, icons or automatic elements).
